followups.complaint: Where is my order ORD-4512? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
followups.reply: An order counts as late 2 business days after its delivery estimate. If it hasn't arrived by then, contact us and we'll open a trace with the courier.
followups.followup: It's been three more business days now and it still hasn't come. What happens next?

followups.complaint: The blender I received is broken. Can I get a replacement?
followups.reply: Yes. Report it within 48 hours with photos and choose a free replacement or a full refund. Replacements ship within 2 business days.
followups.followup: Actually I'd rather have my money back. I paid by card, so how long until I see it?

followups.complaint: I forgot my password and can't log in.
followups.reply: Click Forgot password? and we'll send a 6-digit code by email or SMS, valid for 15 minutes.
followups.followup: I waited ages and nothing ever arrived in my inbox. What should I do now?

followups.complaint: Can I change the delivery address? I just placed the order an hour ago.
followups.reply: Yes, you can change it under My Account > Orders until the order is dispatched.
followups.followup: Hmm, the app now shows it went out this morning. Is it too late?

followups.complaint: I want to return the shoes I bought last week. How do I get a refund?
followups.reply: Go to My Account > Orders, choose Return Item, and schedule a free pickup. Refunds are issued after inspection.
followups.followup: Instead of sending them back for money, could I just get a bigger pair?

followups.complaint: You charged my card three times for order ORD-4719!
followups.reply: Duplicate charges are usually reversed by your bank within 5 to 7 business days.
followups.followup: It has been ten days and the money still isn't back on my statement.
